description: site at which data was collected, concatenated with study to prevent confusion
total cortical gray matter volume
calculation: FreeSurfer = Total cortical gray matter volume | synthseg pipelines = left cerebral cortex + right cerebral cortex

description: subcortical gray matter volume
calculation: FreeSurfer = Subcortical gray matter volume (thalamus, caudate nucleus, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, and nucleus accumbens area) | synthseg pipelines = left thalamus + left caudate + left putamen + left pallidum + left hippocampus + left amygdala + left accumbens area + right thalamus + right caudate + right putamen + right pallidum + right hippocampus + right amygdala + right accumbens area

description: Total cortical  white matter volume
calculation: FreeSurfer = Total cortical or cerebral white matter volume | synthseg pipelines = left cerebral white matter + right cerebral white matter
notes: "cortical" vs "cerebral" wording depends on FreeSurfer version

description: combined volume of ventricles
calculation: FreeSurfer = BrainSegVol minus BrainSegVolNotVent | synthseg pipelines = “Ventricles” or left lateral ventricle + right lateral ventricle + left inferior lateral ventricle + right inferior lateral ventricle + third ventricle + fourth ventricle

description: cerebellar volume
calculation: sum of left cerebellum cortex, right cerebellum cortex, left cerebellum white matter, right cerebellum white matter

description: total brain tissue volume
calculation: sum of WMV, sGMV, GMV, and CBV

description: mean of all regional cortical thickness phenotypes
calculation: mean of all 68 Desikan-Killiany regions' thickness measures

description: sum of  regional surface area phenotypes
calculation: sum across all 68 Desikan-Killiany regions' surface area measures
